title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Lite
justification: AniList 15687 (ONA, 6 episode(s) from 2012-09-27) is AniDB 8883's special(s) S2-S7, aired 2012-09-27 to 2012-10-31. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8883. The parent's row start 2 end 7 offset 3 puts S2-S7 on TVDB 0x5-0x10 (the overlay/8883.json version of the row keeps this range).
